# Translation Document

id: translation
Version: 1.0
Status: draft
Abstraction: process
changelog-path: CHANGELOGS/translation.changes.md

## Purpose

This document defines the translation workflow for the project.
Translation is a core responsibility of all contributors.

## Scope

The scope covers EN→RU translation quality and structural drift.
Documentation ensures consistency across repositories.

## Rules

Every change must pass the four phase-4 gates.
No exceptions for inline code or numerical literals.
Review each section carefully for glossary compliance.

## Process

Follow the established workflow for all translations.
Submit completed translations for peer review.
Track all changes in the project log.
